plays.description: Opening rushing play; commentary reports a gain of 13.
Pumps on third-and-6 and is sacked by Jones against an extra rusher.
plays.coverage_scheme: man-to-man on the outside, described immediately afterward

plays.description: Retrospective commentary says Carlton Davis nearly intercepted the first throw for a potential pick-six.
Receives a handoff; result is missing.
Escapes pursuit on third-and-5. An out-of-bounds hit draws an unnecessary-roughness penalty; commentary tentatively identifies Derick Hall.
plays.defender_beaten: Derick Hall (tentative identification of penalized defender)

plays.description: Commentary credits an unnamed receiver with a key third-down conversion against Devon Witherspoon.
Third-and-2 flea-flicker deep toward Brown draws defensive pass interference on Josh Jobe. DB records a 34-yard penalty and no play; captions say 35.
Catches Maye's 2-yard touchdown pass short left.
plays.personnel_formation: Gilliam at fullback; Stevenson at tailback

plays.description: Drew Lock completes a deep-middle pass for 21 yards on the third-and-22 sequence. Receiver and yardage are supplied by the matching DB entry.
Runs left and runs into his offensive lineman; final result is missing.
On fourth-and-4, Chazz Surratt gets to the punter and a personal foul gives New England a first down.
Stevenson play stopped by Nwosu; commentary praises the defensive play without supplying yardage.
Makes a 50-yard field goal, extending New England's lead to 10-0; success is established by the DB.
Catches Maye's underneath throw from the end zone and is stopped at the NE 10 against a four-man rush.
Catches Lock's deep-right pass for 24 yards on third-and-3, reaching the NE 13. Commentary describes stacking Kupp behind another player to ensure his release; Holani stays in to block.
plays.personnel_formation: Kupp stacked behind another player; Holani stays in to block

plays.description: Patriots bring pressure. Commentary describes separation involving Carlton Davis, but disrupted timing produces a missed pass; target is unclear.
plays.coverage_scheme: man coverage described in the surrounding sequence

plays.description: Makes a 30-yard field goal to cut the deficit to 10-3; success is established by the DB.
Protected play-action deep left toward Doubs is deflected with Rodney Thomas covering and intercepted by Nehemiah Pritchett. DB records a 30-yard return to SEA 33; captions say the 34.

Catches Lock's short-left pass and scores a 45-yard touchdown. Commentary anticipates a one-on-one opportunity and then describes ample space. Later commentary identifies the touchdown pass as occurring on fourth-and-short.
plays.coverage_scheme: one-on-one matchup anticipated by commentator; full scheme unknown

plays.description: A defender gets around Jared Wilson on a play resulting in a loss of 4. Ball carrier and play type are unclear.
Moves outside, keeps his eyes downfield and throws; the unidentified target cannot bring it in.
On third-and-14 against a twisting four-man rush, Maye throws deep middle and Julian Love intercepts. DB records no return, despite captions describing a return to the 32.
Retrospective commentary identifies a third-and-3 run that set up fourth-and-very-short before the touchdown pass.
Looks toward Cooper Kupp and throws; destination and outcome are cut off.
With receivers covered, scrambles from the NE 17 and turns the corner, finishing just short of a first down.
On third-and-6, Lock goes left and throws toward Smith-Njigba from a backfield alignment. Exact result is missing; Seattle subsequently settles for a field goal.
Makes the go-ahead 26-yard field goal for a 13-10 lead; success is established by the DB.
An offensive player restricts Derick Hall with his left hand on the shoulder pad, drawing a penalty that leaves first-and-20.
Murphy pressures up the middle and additional defenders finish the sack.
Takes a deep drop and completes a middle throw from a clean pocket; receiver and gain are missing.
Runs out of bounds on a fourth-down conversion, confirmed retrospectively at 13:48.
Makes a run praised by the announcer with 3:42 remaining; gain and direction are missing.
Commentary describes an available tight-end screen that Maye did not throw and Vera-Tucker starting early; a penalty backs New England up.
Faces pressure on the late drive; the caption cuts off before the outcome.
Maye has time on third-and-long and throws toward Henry; completion and gain are not explicitly preserved.
Fourth-and-9 conversion attributed to Hollins in the surrounding commentary. Seattle shows pressure and backs out; commentary calls Hollins the team's zone buster.
After the quick look is closed, Maye throws a deep-right end-zone jump ball for Hollins. Josh Jobe intercepts for a touchback; DB also credits pressure to D. Lawrence.
Takes a knee to close the game.

offense_strengths: The flea-flicker toward A.J. Brown drew a 34-yard pass-interference penalty, followed by Raridon's 2-yard touchdown reception.
The final drive included fourth-down conversions through Maye's running and a play attributed to Hollins against zone.
An unnamed receiver converted a third down against Witherspoon.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Lock's 21-yard middle completion to Smith-Njigba and 24-yard deep-right completion to Kupp.
Allowed Smith-Njigba's 45-yard touchdown on a short-left pass after commentary anticipated a one-on-one opportunity.

offense_strengths: Lock produced substantial completions to Smith-Njigba and Kupp, including the tying 45-yard touchdown.
Kupp's stacked alignment was explicitly credited with helping him get a release on his 24-yard catch.
defense_weaknesses: Jobe's deep pass interference against Brown put New England at the 2 before its touchdown.
An unnecessary-roughness penalty and Surratt's personal foul on the punter extended New England possessions.
Allowed two fourth-down conversions on New England's final drive, including Hollins' conversion against zone.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were viewed or commands run. Fragmented captions leave many gains, targets, outcomes and play boundaries unknown. Isolated pre-snap discussion and fragments without an identifiable action were omitted. DB entries were matched only where the sequence clearly supported them; DB-only kickoffs were not added. For interceptions, yards is null because passing yardage is not supplied; return yardage is described separately. Field-goal yards denotes kick distance, and the flea-flicker entry uses penalty yardage. Named defenders include tacklers, interceptors and defenders who won their matchup; their inclusion does not mean they were beaten. Formation and coverage details come only from commentary; nearby coverage discussion may not establish a complete scheme. Caption/DB discrepancies were resolved in favor of the supplied authoritative DB.
